test_AdsorbateSlabConfig_slab_only: test AdsorbateSlabConfig initialization using pre-extracted slab atoms instead of generating from bulk
test_AdsorbateSlabConfig_augmentations: test AdsorbateSlabConfig num_augmentations_per_site parameter to generate multiple structures per single binding site

test_AdsorbateSlabConfig_modes: test AdsorbateSlabConfig random and heuristic modes to verify adsorbate center of mass or binding atom alignment
